skill.name: email-campaign-writer
skill.description: Generate email marketing copy from product information, including five subject line options, body copy, CTAs, and A/B testing ideas.
skill.summary: Create email campaign drafts with subject lines, body copy, calls to action, and A/B test ideas.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

security_audit.summary: The static high-entropy alert appears to be a false positive. SKILL.md is a short UTF-8 Markdown file with Chinese marketing copy text, metadata, and usage notes, with no binary payload, encoded content, or prompt injection evidence.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.25 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is a 34-line Markdown document with visible UTF-8 Chinese text and simple skill metadata. I found no binary blob, encrypted content, encoded payload, or hidden prompt injection text.

content.value_statement: Email campaigns need clear benefits, subject lines, and testable calls to action. This skill turns product details into draft campaign copy and A/B test ideas.
actual_capabilities: Generates email marketing copy from product information.
Creates five subject line options for a campaign.
Drafts email body copy with a clear offer.
Adds calls to action for the campaign goal.
Suggests A/B testing ideas for campaign comparison.
limitations: It depends on the quality of the product details provided.
It does not send emails or connect to marketing platforms.
It does not verify legal, privacy, or deliverability compliance.
Human review is needed for brand voice and factual claims.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Email
use_cases.description: Turn product benefits, offer details, and audience notes into a launch campaign draft.

use_cases.title: Promote a Service Package
use_cases.description: Create concise email copy that explains a service offer and invites readers to book.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Sales Newsletter
use_cases.description: Draft subject lines, body copy, and CTA options for a scheduled promotion.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Basic Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Write an email campaign for [product]. Include five subject lines, one body, one CTA, and one A/B test idea.

prompt_templates.title: Match Brand Voice
prompt_templates.prompt: Create campaign copy for [product] in a [tone] voice. Use these benefits: [benefits]. Avoid these words: [words].

prompt_templates.title: Segment the Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Write two email versions for [product], one for [segment A] and one for [segment B]. Include subject lines and CTAs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A/B Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop an email campaign for [offer]. Include five subject lines, body copy, CTA options, and three A/B test hypotheses.

output_examples.input: A new task app for freelancers who manage many client projects.
output_examples.output: The draft includes five subject lines, a concise benefit-led email, a trial CTA, and a subject line test idea.

output_examples.input: A limited discount for an online design course ending Friday.
output_examples.output: The draft presents urgency, course outcomes, a direct enrollment CTA, and an A/B test for deadline framing.

output_examples.input: A consulting package for small businesses improving repeat sales.
output_examples.output: The draft explains the business result, suggests practical subject lines, and compares booking CTAs for testing.

best_practices: Provide audience, offer, product benefits, deadline, and brand tone before asking for copy.
Review claims, pricing, links, and consent language before sending any campaign.
Test one variable at a time so A/B results are easier to read.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a campaign without product, audience, or offer details.
Do not send generated copy without checking facts and compliance needs.
Do not test many copy changes at once if you need clear learning.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates subject lines, email body copy, calls to action, and A/B testing ideas from product details.

faq.question: Does it send emails?
faq.answer: No. It drafts copy only and does not connect to email platforms.

faq.question: Can it match a brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide tone examples, audience details, and words to avoid.

faq.question: Does it replace legal review?
faq.answer: No. Review claims, consent language, and regulated product statements before sending.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: It lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide product benefits, audience, offer, deadline, brand tone, and required links.
